people.title: People and device IDs
people.subtitle: Everyone has a number on the devices. Set who has which ID here; a new ID is sent to every active device by itself.
people.noDevices: No active device yet; IDs can be sent once a device is added.
people.unknownHint: Punches arrived with ID <v>{id}</v>, but nobody has that ID. Type <v>{id}</v> in the right person’s row and save.

edit.label: {name}’s device ID
edit.hint: Enter saves; leave it empty to clear the ID.
edit.reenrol: {name}’s ID changed from {previous} to {id}. Their fingerprints stay under the old ID on the devices, so they must enrol their finger again on each device.
edit.stillOnDeviceLink: See IDs still on the devices

defaults.title: Assign default IDs
defaults.description: Only people without an ID get one: a student gets their code’s number (S-0123 gives 123), staff the next free number from the staff range. Nobody’s ID changes.
defaults.willGet: {count} will get an ID ({students} students, {staff} staff).
defaults.conflictSHARED: ID {id} also comes from another student’s code
defaults.conflictNO_DEFAULT: No ID can be made from the code
defaults.conflictID_STILL_ON_DEVICE: A device still has {name} under ID {id}
defaults.conflictID_STILL_ON_DEVICE_UNKNOWN: A device still has someone else under ID {id}
defaults.conflictsHint: Give them an ID by hand in the list; they also show under collisions.
defaults.appliedSent: {count} people got an ID; sending to the devices
defaults.appliedNone: Nobody new got an ID; the list changed meanwhile.

send.nobody: Nobody to send; give people IDs first.
send.done: Sending {queued} names to {devices} devices. Each picks them up next time it calls.
send.doneSkipped: Sending {queued} names to {devices} devices; {skipped} were already waiting.

import.title: IDs from a CSV
import.description: Fill the device_id column of the downloaded CSV and upload it here. You see what would change first, then apply it.
import.tooBig: The file is larger than 1 MB. Make it smaller and try again.
import.errorsSkipped: Rows with errors are skipped; the rest are applied. Fix them and upload again later.

error.BOTH_KEYS: Both student_code and staff_phone; keep one
error.UNKNOWN_STAFF: No staff member has this phone number
error.BAD_DEVICE_ID: The ID must be 3 to 9 digits, not starting with 0
error.DUPLICATE_PERSON: The same person is in the file more than once
error.DUPLICATE_ID: The same ID is on more than one row
error.TAKEN: Someone else has this ID, and the file does not change theirs
error.ID_STILL_ON_DEVICE: A device still has someone else under this ID; remove them from the devices first

import.applied: {count} IDs changed; sending to the devices
import.appliedSkipped: {count} IDs changed; {errors} rows with errors were skipped
import.appliedNone: Nothing changed; check the file again.

collisions.title: ID collisions ({count})
collisions.hint: These numbers are someone’s default ID but another person holds them, or several codes give the same number. Give the person without an ID another one.
collisions.shared: Nobody’s yet, but more than one code gives it

stale.title: IDs still on the devices ({count})
stale.hint: The devices still have fingerprints under these IDs from someone who should no longer be there. Until they are removed, the ID can’t go to anyone else: their finger would punch as the new person.
stale.reasonINACTIVE: No longer active here, still on the devices
stale.reasonRELEASED: The ID was taken from them, but their fingerprints are still on the device
stale.confirmBody: The ID and the fingerprints under it are deleted from every device. Once the devices confirm, the ID is free again. Anyone who comes back enrols their finger again.
stale.done: Removing {count} from the devices; each device deletes them next time it calls.
